title: "Figure 4 (tentative C) — the score itself: does the mean score vanish at the simulation truth, member by member, along the interval axis"

<!--
TENTATIVE. Written 2026-08-04. Not numbered, not in the manuscript.

WHY THIS EXISTS. figure_4_interval_pairs.Rmd plots the distortion-INDUCED bias, which
Lapack_Likelihood_Distortion_Induced_Bias_Subspace computes as H^-1 g: the one-step Newton
displacement of a member's optimum away from theta_sim. That is a product of two things, and a large
value can come either from a score that genuinely fails to vanish or from an ill-conditioned reported
information whose inverse amplifies a small one. At N_ch = 10 the second is a live possibility.
This notebook removes the Hessian from the question and looks at the score directly.

WHAT IS PLOTTED. Probit_statistics_Moment_statistics_Sum_dlogL with statistic = "mean": the mean over
recordings of the score summed over the record, evaluated at theta_sim on battery_sim_G. Null zero.
It is a VECTOR, so it is indexed by param_index alone and there is no diagonal to take.

TWO PANELS PER PARAMETER, and the second is the one to read.
  RAW      the mean score in its own units. Members are not comparable on this scale, since a member
           with a sharper likelihood has a larger score for the same data.
  STANDARDISED  z = mean / sqrt(J_ii / n), with J the score covariance emitted alongside as
           statistic = "covariance" (a matrix, so param_index == param_col picks its diagonal) and n
           the emitted count. This is how many standard errors the mean score sits from zero, which
           IS the identity being tested, and it is comparable across members and cells.

THE QUESTION IT ANSWERS. At N_ch = 10 and Delta*k_off = 0.01 the induced bias reads 0.027 for NR
against 0 for INR, and it does not scale with the interval: over a hundredfold change in Delta the NR
value moves only from 0.027 to 0.055. Whatever produces that floor is therefore not the interval
averaging, whose contribution is O(lambda*Delta) and would have to move a hundredfold. If the floor
is in the score, NR is genuinely displaced and something in its likelihood other than the window is
responsible. If the floor is not in the score, it is the inverse information doing the work and the
induced bias cannot be read as a displacement of the optimum.

BOOTSTRAP. Same machinery as the companion notebooks and the same caveat: the classical
nonparametric bootstrap of legacy/bootstrap.h resampling GROUPS, not recordings
(src/core/likelihood.cpp:4278), B = 100, centre taken as the median because the mean over replicates
of a nonlinear functional carries a Jensen bias. For the raw score the functional is linear, so mean
and median agree there; the median is kept for consistency with the standardised panel, where the
ratio is not.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(patchwork) })
```

```{r constants}
DATA_DIRS <- c("../data/1c2ae6f", "../data/87889e6", "../data/0ffbda7", "../data/1f7138b")
NOISE     <- "0.1"
NCH_ENDS  <- c(10, 10000)
SCORE     <- "Probit_statistics_Moment_statistics_Sum_dlogL"

PAIRS <- tribble(
  ~pair,      ~naive,       ~aware,
  "LSE/ILSE", "macro_LSE",  "macro_ILSE",
  "NR/INR",   "macro_NR",   "macro_INR",
  "R/IR",     "macro_R",    "macro_IR"
)
PARAMS   <- c(off = 1, Num_ch_mean = 5)
PAR_LAB  <- c(off = "k[off]", Num_ch_mean = "N[ch]")
MEM_COL  <- c("interval-naive" = "#D55E00", "interval-aware" = "#0072B2")
X_BRK    <- c(0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1)

findf <- function(nch, algo, z, kind) {
  f <- file.path(DATA_DIRS,
       sprintf("figure_3_G_nch_%d_nsim_10000_%s_noise_%s_%s.csv", nch, algo, z, kind))
  f <- f[file.exists(f)]
  if (!length(f)) NA_character_ else f[1]
}
```

```{r data}
grid <- expand_grid(PAIRS, nch = NCH_ENDS) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(naive, aware), names_to = "member", values_to = "algo") %>%
  mutate(member = if_else(member == "naive", "interval-naive", "interval-aware"))

raw <- pmap_dfr(grid, function(pair, nch, member, algo) {
  f <- findf(nch, algo, NOISE, "battery_sim_G")
  if (is.na(f)) return(NULL)
  read.csv(f, skip = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    filter(component_path == SCORE,
           (param_index %in% PARAMS) | statistic == "count") %>%   # count is a scalar: no param_index
    transmute(pair, nch, member,
              interval = as.numeric(interval_in_tau),
              param = names(PARAMS)[match(param_index, PARAMS)],
              statistic, probit, quantile_level, param_col, value)
})
stopifnot(nrow(raw) > 0)

# the mean score: a vector, no diagonal to take
sc <- raw %>%
  filter(statistic == "mean", probit == "quantile",
         quantile_level %in% c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)) %>%
  mutate(key = case_when(quantile_level == 0.5   ~ "mid",
                         quantile_level == 0.025 ~ "lo",
                         TRUE                    ~ "hi")) %>%
  select(pair, nch, member, interval, param, key, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = value)

# the score covariance: a matrix, its diagonal, at the median replicate
jj <- raw %>%
  filter(statistic == "covariance", probit == "quantile", quantile_level == 0.5) %>%
  filter(as.character(param_col) == as.character(PARAMS[match(param, names(PARAMS))])) %>%
  select(pair, nch, member, interval, param, J = value)

nn <- raw %>%
  filter(statistic == "count") %>%
  group_by(pair, nch, member, interval) %>% summarise(n = median(value), .groups = "drop")

d <- sc %>% left_join(jj, by = c("pair","nch","member","interval","param")) %>%
            left_join(nn, by = c("pair","nch","member","interval")) %>%
  mutate(se = sqrt(J / n), z = mid / se, zlo = lo / se, zhi = hi / se,
         nlab = factor(sprintf("N[ch] == %d", nch), levels = sprintf("N[ch] == %d", NCH_ENDS)),
         member = factor(member, levels = c("interval-naive", "interval-aware")))

ok <- d %>% distinct(pair, nch, member) %>% count(pair, nch) %>%
      group_by(pair) %>% filter(all(n == 2), n_distinct(nch) == length(NCH_ENDS)) %>%
      ungroup() %>% distinct(pair) %>% pull(pair)
d <- d %>% filter(pair %in% ok)
cat("pairs complete at both ends:", paste(ok, collapse = " "), " rows:", nrow(d), "\n")
```

```{r plot, fig.width = 6.0, fig.height = 5.0}
base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 8, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(.14, "cm"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7.5), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 6.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5.5),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(.6, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5), plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = .5),
        plot.margin = margin(3, 4, 2, 3))

one_pair <- function(dd, pr, ycol, ylo, yhi, ylab) {
  ggplot(filter(dd, pair == pr),
         aes(interval, .data[[ycol]], colour = member, fill = member)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linewidth = .3) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = .data[[ylo]], ymax = .data[[yhi]]), linewidth = .45, alpha = .8) +
    geom_line(linewidth = .5) + geom_point(size = .9) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = X_BRK, labels = as.character(X_BRK)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = MEM_COL) + scale_fill_manual(values = MEM_COL) +
    facet_grid(nlab ~ ., scales = "free_y", labeller = label_parsed) +
    labs(x = expression(widetilde(Delta) == Delta %.% k[off]), y = ylab, colour = NULL, fill = NULL, title = pr) +
    base_theme
}

for (pp in names(PARAMS)) {
  dd <- d %>% filter(param == pp)
  prs <- unique(as.character(dd$pair))
  if (!length(prs)) next
  for (blk in list(list(y = "mid", lo = "lo", hi = "hi", tag = "raw",
                        lab = expression("mean score at "*theta[sim])),
                   list(y = "z", lo = "zlo", hi = "zhi", tag = "z",
                        lab = "mean score / standard error"))) {
    gl <- lapply(prs, function(pr)
      one_pair(dd, pr, blk$y, blk$lo, blk$hi, if (pr == prs[1]) blk$lab else NULL))
    g <- wrap_plots(gl, nrow = 1) +
      plot_annotation(subtitle = parse(text = PAR_LAB[pp])) +
      plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    print(g)
    ggsave(sprintf("Figure_4_score_%s_%s.pdf", blk$tag, pp), g,
           width = 3.0 * length(prs), height = 4.4)
  }
}
```

```{r numbers}
cat("\n=== mean score in standard errors, at the short end (Delta*k_off = 0.01) ===\n")
d %>% filter(interval == 0.01) %>%
  select(pair, nch, param, member, mean_score = mid, se, z) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(z))) %>% print(n = 40)

cat("\n=== does |z| scale with the interval? floor test: |z| at 0.01 against |z| at 1 ===\n")
d %>% filter(interval %in% c(0.01, 1)) %>%
  select(pair, nch, param, member, interval, z) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = interval, values_from = z, names_prefix = "d") %>%
  mutate(fold = abs(d1) / pmax(abs(d0.01), 1e-12)) %>%
  arrange(fold) %>% print(n = 40)
```
